title: Remove Diagnostics tail render flat export
summary: Removed the Diagnostics tail renderer from the transitional flat window export set while preserving the namespace export and namespace-backed smoke coverage.
reason: Continue the opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup by touched domain without changing backend authority, Diagnostics behavior, or media mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js exported renderDiagnosticsTail both through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView and as window.renderDiagnosticsTail, and the Diagnostics browser smoke invoked the legacy flat hook directly.
behavior_after: diagnosticsView.js keeps renderDiagnosticsTail on window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView only, the browser smoke invokes that namespace member, and static coverage rejects reintroducing the flat window assignment.
tests_added: Updated LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert the Diagnostics namespace export remains present and the flat renderDiagnosticsTail assignment is absent.
Updated the Diagnostics browser handoff smoke to invoke mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView.renderDiagnosticsTail instead of window.renderDiagnosticsTail.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke -q (passes with the existing malformed broken-active-job.json warning)
rollback_plan: Restore the window.renderDiagnosticsTail assignment in diagnosticsView.js, move the smoke back to the flat hook if needed, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the flat-export counts/inventory entry.
notes:
Removed the legacy renderDiagnosticsTail flat export while retaining the Diagnostics namespace member.
Added static coverage that renderDiagnosticsTail remains namespace-exported and is no longer assigned as a flat window export.
Moved the Diagnostics tail browser smoke from the flat render hook to the namespace export.
Updated the tracked WebView flat-export count after the Diagnostics cleanup.
Updated the Diagnostics flat-export inventory and total.
Regenerated the WebView public contract baseline after removing the flat export.
